relationToInstitutionalLogo._note: readme.md §7 — la atribución es una divulgación, no una marca co-líder.
relationToInstitutionalLogo.minimumSeparation: área de protección completa del logo institucional + 24px
rules: never place inside the Universidad de La Sabana logo protection area
never align both logos implying a single combined lockup
no dividing line that visually merges both marks
must remain smaller and lower in hierarchy than the institutional logo
if both marks would share the same corner in a template, move the AI attribution to the opposite lower corner while keeping the institutional logo fixed
must never force the institutional logo to shrink below its recommended presentation size

referencePattern: Diseñado con Claude Design
validatorChecks: claudeDisclosureSeparated (no colisiona con el logo institucional)
